capabilities: Open wikilinks in a centred peek panel
Show frontmatter properties as chips under the title
Step back through links opened inside the panel
Edit the peeked note in an embedded Live Preview editor
Open the peeked note in a new tab or to the right
extras: The embedded Live Preview editor uses Obsidian internals outside the official plugin API, so it may need adjusting after major Obsidian updates; installation is manual (copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css), with no build step.
intentEvidence: opens wikilinks in a centred, Notion-style peek panel instead of navigating away
problem: Clicking a wikilink replaces the note you are reading, so you lose your place when you only want a quick look at the linked note.

relations.evidence: opens wikilinks in a centred, Notion-style peek panel

summary: Opens wikilinks in a centred floating panel with a properties table and Live Preview editing, instead of navigating away from the current note.
